methodology.scope: Curated seed index, not all Steam games.
methodology.steamdbImport: 29 observed Visuals & Viewpoint terms; direct HTTP fetch returned 403, so no bulk crawl or automatic sync is claimed.
methodology.axes: Art style, rendering dimensions, perspective, presentation and evaluative descriptors are separated editorially.
methodology.mapping: Family and vocabulary mappings are our design interpretation, not verified SteamDB tag profiles for every game.
methodology.coverage: Covered means at least one local complete experimental reference Skill in that family; variants can remain unmade.
methodology.metrics: No SteamDB title counts, keyword volume, sales or demand scores are used.
